settings.title: Architectural styling for the season.
settings.intro: We look at the doorway as part of the whole home. A seasonal display should feel considered in its colors, proportions, and placement.
settings.body_one: Height matters on a broad stair. A narrow stoop needs room to breathe. For a storefront, the display should welcome people without hiding the entrance. These are the practical details behind an intentional composition.
settings.body_two: Begin with the scale of your space, then choose a color story. Notes in your brief are the place to describe the architecture, an event date, or a particular detail you would like considered. Individual pumpkins and gourds may vary with the harvest.
